artworks.title: Leonardos Philaras
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of an individual facing slightly to the left. The person's body is visible from the chest up, with the head turned slightly to the left. The person has an elongated face with delicate features, including a prominent nose and full lips. Their eyes gaze slightly to the left with a composed expression. The hair is curly and shoulder-length, with a styled appearance, and wearing a cap or hat. They are dressed in period attire with a high-collared garment with intricate detailing. The background is plain with no additional details.

artworks.title: Raffaello Menicucci
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man facing slightly to the left. He has distinct facial features, a prominent mustache, and a serious expression. He is wearing a high-collared shirt with a textured design. The background consists of parallel horizontal lines. The text below the portrait reads "RAPHAEL MENICVCIVS Celeberrimus in vtroq orbe terrarum," along with credits.

artworks.title: Raffaello Menicucci
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man with a prominent and high forehead, rounded eyebrows, a mustache, short curly hair, wearing a shirt with a ruffled collar and a garment with a textured, striped pattern. The background consists of horizontal lines. The inscription below the portrait reads, "RAPHAEL MENICUCIVS," with additional text about the artist and location.

artworks.title: Raffaello Menicucci
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-level portrait of a man, capturing his face and upper shoulders. He is positioned slightly to the side, gazing towards the viewer with an expressionless demeanor. The man has a closely cropped hairstyle with dark hair, a prominent mustache, and defined facial features, including almond-shaped eyes and a rounded chin. He is dressed in a garment featuring a high, turned-down collar and a striped pattern on the fabric. The background consists of closely spaced horizontal lines, creating a textured effect. Below the image, text identifies the subject as "RAPHAEL MENICVCIVS," framed by additional inscription detail.

artworks.title: Raffaello Menicucci
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of a man facing slightly at an angle and looking directly at the viewer. He has a serious expression, arched eyebrows, a prominent nose, and a mustache. His hair is short and curly. He is wearing a garment with a high collar and textured or patterned fabric. The background consists of parallel lines. The style of the portrait is typical of historical portraiture.

artworks.title: Louis Berryer
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.4 x 13.1 cm (7 5/8 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man in a bust view, facing slightly to his left. He has long, wavy hair and a mustache, with distinctive facial features. He wears an ornate garment with intricate detailing. The border includes his name, "LVDOVICVS BERRIER," and other text. Below the portrait is a decorative heraldic shield. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface surrounded by a circular frame, emphasizing the central figure.

artworks.title: Henriette Anne of England, Duchess of Orléans
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a person in an ornate frame. The individual is looking directly at the viewer, with delicate facial features, soft, round eyes, and a small, full mouth. They have long, wavy hair with pearls and a decorative accessory. The person is dressed in elegant attire with a high neckline. The frame has intricate decorations and floral motifs. Text below the portrait provides information about the person.

artworks.title: Abel Servien
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in profile facing left. He has a long mustache, a goatee, a prominent nose, and is slightly smiling. His curly shoulder-length hair falls in defined waves. He is dressed formally with a high collar, a robe or cloak, an ornate brooch, and a diagonal sash. In the background, there is a decorative border resembling draped cloth. The image is titled at the bottom with an inscription of the man's titles or achievements.

artworks.title: Philippe Thibaud
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15.6 x 10.7 cm (6 1/8 x 4 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait depicting the head and upper torso of an elderly man. He is facing forward and slightly to his right, with a formal and composed posture within an oval frame. The man has prominent facial features, deep-set eyes, a slightly downturned mouth, and minimal hair. He wears a hooded cloak that covers his head and bunches around his shoulders. The background of the engraving features decorative borders, fine lines for texture, and cursive inscription above and below the portrait.

artworks.title: Claude de Marolles
artworks.description: This is a portrait engraving of a man. He is facing slightly to the viewer's right, with curly hair, a receding hairline, a beard, and a mustache. He is wearing an elaborate ruffled collar and a formal garment with a patterned design, possibly a cape. The background consists of fine horizontal lines and the image is framed by an ornate border with text at the bottom in Latin.

artworks.title: Nicolas Coeffeteau
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29.1 x 20.9 cm (11 7/16 x 8 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body with distinct facial features, deep-set eyes, a prominent brow, and a long beard. He is wearing a large angular hat and a robe-like garment with a high collar and visible buttons. The background is plain with subtle diagonal lines.

artworks.title: Jean-François Paul de Gondi, Cardinal of Retz
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a person from the chest up, in a slightly three-quarter pose against an oval background. The individual is facing slightly to the right, with their gaze directed towards the viewer. They have shoulder-length hair with curls, a mustache, and goatee. The person is dressed in historical attire with a dark, buttoned garment and a wide, pointed white collar. They wear a large cross pendant around their neck. The upper background features textured lines around the oval portrait. Below the portrait, there is a coat of arms with religious symbols and a hat. The composition is framed by plain borders.

artworks.title: Armand Jean du Plessis, Cardinal Richelieu
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up seated behind a table. He is in a side profile position with his body slightly turned towards the viewer, holding a quill pen above a document. His facial features include a mustache and a patch of chin hair, with high cheekbones and a thoughtful expression. He has short, slightly wavy hair brushed back. The man is wearing an ornate robe with an embroidered cross on the chest and a decorative chain around his neck. A draped curtain with a tassel is behind him, and there is a view of a seascape in the background. Two cherubs with a laurel wreath are above him.

artworks.title: Henri-Louis Habert de Montmor
artworks.description: The image features an engraved portrait of a man seated and posed with his head slightly turned to the right. He has a mustache and a goatee, with curly hair that falls to his shoulders. His face is detailed, showing arched eyebrows and thoughtful eyes. He wears a robe with a wide white collar. The background includes an oval frame design around the man's face. The text below the portrait includes the name "Henricus Ludovicus Habert de Montmor Ioann. Fil." along with additional notes in Latin or possibly French.

artworks.title: Mathieu Mole
artworks.description: This is an oval portrait of an older man showing a bust view. The man is positioned facing slightly to the right with a calm expression. His facial features include a prominent nose, bushy eyebrows, and a long white beard. He has curly graying hair and wears a small cap. He is dressed in a robe or coat with a fur-trimmed collar and a striped pattern. The background inside the oval has fine lines creating a textured halo effect, while the outer background and the entire image are detailed with fine etching lines. Below the oval is a decorative crest or coat of arms.

artworks.title: Claude de Rebe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up facing slightly to the viewer's right. He has a mustache, short beard, dark hair styled back, and wears a skullcap. The man wears clerical attire with a large, white, square collar over a dark robe and a cross emblem around his neck. He has a calm expression and looks straight ahead. The background has evenly spaced lines, and below the image is a label with text that reads, "CLAVDIVS DE REBE ARCHIEPISC. ET PRIMAS NARBONENSIS."

artworks.title: Alphonse III Delbene, Bishop of Orléans
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He is shown from the upper body up, positioned slightly turned to his left but looking directly at the viewer. His facial features include a mustache and slightly curly hair, with a cap on his head. He wears a clerical robe with an upturned collar and a large cross hanging from his neck. He is set in an oval frame with a linear background. Below the oval, there is a small shield with a coat of arms detail.

artworks.title: Pierre Seguier
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 31 x 23 cm (12 3/16 x 9 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a man seated in a forward position. He has a pointed chin beard, mustache, curly dark hair, wears a dark robe with a large, white collar, and is set against a background with a fleur-de-lis pattern. Inscribed text at the bottom of the image reads "PETRVS SEGVIER FRANCIAE CANCELLARIVS."

artworks.title: Vincenzo Giustiniani
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 30 x 21 cm (11 13/16 x 8 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a depiction of a man with distinct facial features, wearing a garment with a frilled collar. In the background, there are finely etched lines creating an oval frame around the figure, within a plain rectangular border. An inscription below the portrait reads "VINCENTIVS IVSTINIANVS IOSEPHI F," accompanied by additional text indicating the name of the artist and the date, "Claude Mellan Gall' del. et Sculp. Roma 1631." The overall style suggests a classical engraving.

artworks.title: Omer Talon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up. He is facing slightly towards his right. His expression is neutral, with deep-set eyes, a well-defined nose, short beard, and mustache. His hair is slightly curly, peeking out from under a small cap. The man is wearing a garment with a large, white folded collar, overlaid with a dark robe with detailed line patterns. There is a visible chain or medallion around his neck. The background consists of an oval frame and a linear pattern. Below the portrait, there is a crest or coat of arms.

artworks.title: Anne of Austria
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 35.3 x 24.1 cm (13 7/8 x 9 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with a round face and gentle features. They have curly hair peeking out from beneath a head covering or hood. The person wears a garment with a large collar and is accessorized with dangling earrings. The background consists of a detailed oval frame surrounding the portrait. Below the frame is an emblem with intertwined letters "M" and "A" topped with a crown. The portrait appears to be engraved and is depicted in a monochrome or sepia tone.

artworks.title: Henri de Mesmes
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 34.8 x 24.8 cm (13 11/16 x 9 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing forward with his head slightly tilted. The man has distinct facial features including arched eyebrows, smiling eyes, a pointed nose, a mustache, and a small beard that tapers to a point at the chin. His medium length wavy hair is parted to the side. He is wearing a patterned garment wrapped around his shoulders. The portrait is framed in an oval shape with detailed linear designs. Below the portrait, there is a coat of arms with a crown, shield divided into sections with symbols, and decorative foliage. The background inside the frame has a lined pattern.

artworks.title: François-Théodore de Nesmond
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man within an intricately detailed frame. The man is depicted from the chest up in a three-quarter view facing slightly to his left. His facial features include a high forehead, a prominent nose, and a well-defined jawline. He has curly, graying hair that rests around his ears and extends onto his forehead. He is wearing a cap fitting closely to his head and a garment with an elaborate, fur-like texture. There is a border framing the portrait and a coat of arms with three crescents below it. The background consists of horizontal lines.

artworks.title: René de Longueil
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in a three-quarter view facing slightly to their left. The individual has prominent facial features, including a mustache and a small goatee, with curly medium-length hair framing their face. They are dressed in an elaborate robe or coat with a thick scarf draped over their shoulders. The portrait is surrounded by a detailed oval frame with a coat of arms and a crown above it in a circular emblem below the frame. The background features fine lines, emphasizing the central figure in the oval portrait frame.
